title: Make the session-list browser guard's motion modes independent of host preferences
outcome: Normal and reduced-motion browser checks select their own motion preference on every supported host and explain preference mismatches.
acceptance: The guard explicitly selects no-preference and reduce using verified browser emulation or supported flags, without changing the host's accessibility settings.
Both modes are exercised independently of host defaults; a preference mismatch reports observed and intended modes and exits nonzero.

completion.summary: Chrome guard forces both motion preferences, checks actual mode, and reports expected/observed values. No acceptance evaluation exists.
